integrity: Analytical min-max and trace-class determinant proofs; finite exact-arithmetic checks are supplementary and cannot establish the infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: The spectral claims concern the original geometric recurrence for fixed real q >= 5. They give a log-scale edge-counting asymptotic with O_q(1) error, exact global edge-deficit sum, and an Euler-product of positive paired points. No individual closed-form zero locations, weights, sharp geometric equivalent, switched recurrence, or uniform-in-q estimates are established.
title: Logarithmic spectral edge law and Euler product for a geometric random-walk polynomial hypergroup
